data.one_liner: Detect mobile screenshots and execute callback functions on iOS and Android.
data.what_it_does: Allows Flutter applications to listen for mobile screenshot events on both iOS and Android platforms. When a screenshot is detected, a provided callback function is executed.
use_when: You need to trigger analytics or logs when users take screenshots.
You want to warn users or take action within the app upon screenshot detection.
avoid_when: You need complex image editing or screen recording features.
Target platforms do not include Android or iOS.
strengths: Simple API to set up screenshot listeners.
weaknesses: Requires manual permission handling on Android.
data.setup_notes: Requires permission handling on Android to access external storage for screenshot detection.
